speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very unusual symptom description. To start our investigation, do you experience any difficulty speaking or swallowing, and have you noticed any tremors in your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; your right-sided clumsiness suggests a focal lesion. Have you noticed any changes in your vision, balance, or sensation on the right side? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI_Brain Findings: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to Immunosuppression. Given the presence of significant demyelinating lesions without enhancement, I need to confirm the underlying immune status. Have you been diagnosed with HIV/AIDS, or are you currently taking immunosuppressive medications for an organ transplant or autoimmune condition?
